items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: my wife, Cathy, or Catherine as she has signed off on the book... my future (at that time) future wife Catherine Shallis or Cathy Morphet

ctx.x: Yeah. I’d like to start with a couple of inquiries about your time in South Africa. When you arrived there as a Caucasian American, what was your place? Apartheid was still in effect. How did you fit? © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

I exploited the hell out of my status as — as you put it, Caucasian but I would simply say white and I’m okay with that, white American. I — if anything — exaggerated my accent. I simply ignored Apartheid and had a built-in excuse not to know about it if you see what I mean. Of course I knew a lot about it because my wife, Cathy, or Catherine as she has signed off on the book, grew up there and was very politically active. But we just played my identity hand to the hilt and got by with a lot a local white South…
Did it help you with your establishment of your jazz center and reaching out for community support and funding and all those things that go along with a teaching job?
